content.text:
Submitted. The repaired proposal keeps the locked **deviation** status at the **preferred** level with two surgical replacements:

1. **21.1 (p0089)** — cap basis now reads "the greater of (a) fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim and (b) USD 1,000,000", using the exact lowercase fee basis and claim anchor (no defined capital-F "Fees", no event anchor, no "all amounts").
2. **21.3 (p0091)** — the payment carve-out is widened from "undisputed Fees for conforming Services" to "Customer's payment obligations are not damages", curing the narrowness flagged by the deterministic check.

The mutual cap sentence, the mutual indirect/consequential exclusion in 21.2 and all Excluded Claims carve-outs were already in the contract and are mapped as already met, so nothing further was added. All official checks and the minimality gate returned ok.
